entities.summary: Carmelo Psaila, better known as Dun Karm Psaila was a Maltese Roman Catholic priest, writer and poet, sometimes called the "bard of Malta". He is widely recognised as the Maltese national poet and as the lyricist for the Maltese national anthem.
